hypr-04-c1.text: Federico Brandmayr (2022). The Political Flexibility of the Self-Fulfilling Prophecy. Sociologica 16(3), 85-104.
hypr-04-c1.quote: in the beginning, a false definition of the situation evoking a new behavior which makes the originally false conception come true.
hypr-04-c1.claim: In 1948 Robert K. Merton, in the paper "The Self-Fulfilling Prophecy" (Antioch Review), formalised one mechanism: "a false definition of the situation evoking a new behaviour which makes the originally false conception come true."

hypr-04-c2.text: Douglas W. Diamond, Philip H. Dybvig (1983). Bank Runs, Deposit Insurance, and Liquidity. Journal of Political Economy 91(3), 401-419 (reprinted in Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis Quarterly Review).
hypr-04-c2.quote: Traditional demand deposit contracts which provide liquidity have multiple equilibria, one of which is a bank run.
hypr-04-c2.claim: The classic formal model is Diamond-Dybvig (1983)
